nodes.name: Supplier spreadsheet webhook
nodes.notes: Receives one CSV or XLSX as multipart/form-data. The required incoming binary field name is `file`.

nodes.name: Validate incoming file
nodes.notes: Fails visibly before the API call when the multipart field is absent or the filename is unsupported.

nodes.name: Upload batch to FastAPI
nodes.notes: Forwards the original binary file to FastAPI. Default HTTP Request behavior stops the workflow on 4xx, 5xx, timeout, or unavailable backend.

nodes.name: Validate batch response
nodes.notes: Treats an unexpected 2xx payload as a workflow failure instead of silently reporting success.

nodes.name: Fetch batch products
nodes.notes: Uses backend-returned product statuses only; it does not repeat validation or approval rules.

nodes.name: Build outcome summary
nodes.notes: Builds orchestration flags exclusively from FastAPI counts and statuses. Review and partial-error flags are independent, so both can be true.

nodes.name: Clean straight-through?
nodes.notes: True only when FastAPI reports zero failed rows and zero products ever requiring review.

assignments.name: notification_message
assignments.value: Batch processed automatically; no human review required.

nodes.name: Automatic success placeholder
nodes.notes: Generic success event. A production integration could replace this with monitoring, catalogue publication, or another approved connector.

nodes.name: Human review involved?
nodes.notes: Uses FastAPI historical/current review counts. It does not approve or reject products.

assignments.name: notification_message
assignments.value: Batch contains products needing human attention; open the Streamlit review queue.

nodes.name: Review notification placeholder
nodes.notes: Credential-free structured notification. Replace with an approved Teams, Slack, email, or ticketing connector in production.

nodes.name: Partial ingestion errors?
nodes.notes: Independent from human-review routing. A batch can execute both true branches.

assignments.name: notification_message
assignments.value: One or more spreadsheet rows failed ingestion; inspect row_errors.

nodes.name: Ingestion alert placeholder
nodes.notes: Credential-free structured alert. Replace with operational alerting or supplier-data remediation workflow in production.

nodes.name: Return batch outcome
nodes.notes: Returns batch ID, batch status, backend-derived counts, attention products, row errors, and all applicable outcome flags.
